meta.name: util-preparek8senv
meta.description: Prepare Kubernetes environment infrastructure by generating K8s manifests for all 3rd party supporting applications for a single target environment defined in CLAUDE.md. Creates/updates ENVIRONMENT.md with per-environment configs and credentials, then generates persistent StatefulSet-based K8s manifests for each 3rd party application (databases, message queues, caches, SSO, API gateways, etc.) directly in the `environment/` folder. Since the `environment/` folder is gitignored, each machine maintains its own independent copy. Ensures all services are remotely accessible using tools from DEVTOOL.md. Trigger on keywords: "prepare k8s environment", "prepare kubernetes", "setup k8s infra", "generate k8s manifests for 3rd party", "prepare environment", "setup infrastructure", "prepare k8s", "init k8s environment", "scaffold k8s environment". Accepts an optional environment argument to select which Kubernetes environment to generate for.

copy.tagline: 为第三方应用生成K8s清单并配置环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地快速搭建Kubernetes开发环境
copy.tagline_en: Generate K8s manifests and configure environment for third-party apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up a Kubernetes development environment locally

howto.what: Claude 会读取项目中的 CLAUDE.md 文件，自动为第三方应用（如数据库、消息队列、缓存等）生成 Kubernetes 配置文件，并创建或更新 ENVIRONMENT.md 来记录环境配置和凭据。所有文件放在 environment/ 文件夹中，该文件夹不会被 Git 跟踪。
howto.when: 当你说出“prepare k8s environment”、“setup k8s infra”、“generate k8s manifests for 3rd party”等关键词时触发。你也可以指定一个环境名称（如 home_server）来为特定环境生成配置。

say.note: 为所有第三方应用生成 K8s 清单文件。
